coreSourcePositive.continuousHarvestMethod: Hold Right-Click (or hold keyboard X) while moving past mature crops
coreSourcePositive.applicability: Ordinary mature crops that do not require tools (such as Parsnip)
coreSourcePositive.status: Verified by community player observations, game input mappings, and code-level Hand-harvest mechanism

evidence.exactExcerpt: Continue watering your crops every day until they grow in to harvestable crops. Your parsnips will be ready to harvest in 4 days.
evidence.controlsExcerpt: Left-Click, C: Use tool or place item | Right-Click, X: Check/Do Action
evidence.context: Walkthrough for the first 4 days of farming; lists standard control bindings in table
evidence.finding: Confirms parsnips mature in 4 days and that Right-Click/X is Check/Do Action, but leaves the crop harvest action implicit.
evidence.strength: Subject-matter reference; textual omission on harvest button

evidence.historyExcerpt: 1.4: Removed "new" input from button press until the button is released. This makes harvesting large numbers of kegs/preserves jars/crystalariums, etc. easier by holding the button without releasing it.
evidence.context: PC and console control mappings table and version history notes
evidence.finding: Confirms Right-Click and keyboard X default to Check/Do Action. Version 1.4 note confirms holding button harvests machines.

evidence.exactExcerpt: Check/Do Action — Set the keybind for checking or doing some action such as: interacting with NPCs, Calendar, Help Wanted, doors, ladders and elevators; picking up an item from the bag slot; picking up forage and loot. Default Right-Click, X
evidence.context: Description of in-game Options menu keybind configuration
evidence.finding: Shows default PC keybind for Check/Do Action is Right-Click / X. Lists example actions without explicitly mentioning field crops.

evidence.exactExcerpt: Seeds and fertilizer are placed on a tilled tile individually by using the left-click control, or on multiple tiles by continuously holding on to the right-click or left-click control and moving the cursor and/or player.
evidence.context: Fertilizing and Planting subsection under Basics
evidence.finding: Records Left-Click for individual seed/fertilizer placement and hold-right/left for continuous placement. No harvest button stated.

evidence.exactExcerpt: HarvestMethod: (Optional) How the crop can be harvested. This can be Grab (crop is harvested by hand) or Scythe (harvested with a scythe). Default Grab.
evidence.context: Technical crop data schema documentation for modding
evidence.finding: Confirms default harvest method in game data is Grab (hand-harvest), distinct from Scythe.
evidence.strength: Game data architecture reference (does not directly document UI player controls)

evidence.exactExcerpt: See TerrainFeatures.HoeDirt::performUseAction in the game code. The Scythe is assigned harvesting method "1" and harvesting by hand is harvesting method "0".
evidence.context: Footnote 2 explaining Golden Walnut drop mechanics during crop harvesting
evidence.finding: Identifies that hand-harvesting crops invokes TerrainFeatures.HoeDirt::performUseAction (harvest method 0).

evidence.author: Elenna101
evidence.exactExcerpt: Or the direction button and right click. (X is automatically mapped to right click) If you hold right click with the mouse not near your character, you'll automatically plant seed and harvest on the tile you're standing on, and then you just have to walk around over your crops to plant and harvest your field.
evidence.context: Community thread discussing differences between PC and mobile controls; reply explaining how PC players harvest large fields
evidence.finding: Player testimony confirming Right-Click and X are mapped to the same action, and that holding Right-Click while walking harvests crops.
evidence.strength: First-hand player operational description on community forum

evidence.author: Automaton Spy
evidence.exactExcerpt: The problem is... You don't NEED the scythe for parsnips. You need the scythe for amaranth or wheat. For ANY other crop, you need to be standing next to it and rightclick it.
evidence.context: Troubleshooting thread where a new player thought parsnips required a scythe; reply clarifying ordinary crop harvesting
evidence.finding: Player confirms that parsnip harvesting on PC is done by standing next to the crop and right-clicking.
evidence.boundaryNote: The poster's broad claim 'For ANY other crop' is an informal player generalization and must NOT be extrapolated (it omits Kale, Unmilled Rice, Fiber Seeds, etc.). Only the parsnip / hand-harvest observation is accepted.
evidence.strength: Player troubleshooting observation on Steam general discussion

evidence.author: NovanHero
evidence.exactExcerpt: Simply hold down the 'x' key (or whatever key is bounded to right click), walk, and your character will harvest and replant instantly as you walk by.
evidence.context: Community PSA tip explaining keyboard harvesting shortcut on PC
evidence.finding: Player tip confirming that keyboard key X (mapped to Right-Click) allows holding and walking to harvest mature crops.
evidence.accessNote: Retrieved via ego-browser DOM evaluation. Direct curl to reddit returned HTTP 403.
evidence.strength: First-hand player tip on community subreddit
